title: Clearance asymmetry, not aquaporin abundance, sets plasma-activated-water selectivity for glioblastoma: a transfer-function dissection
content: Plasma-activated water (PAW) selectively kills glioblastoma cells while sparing normal brain cells, but whether this selectivity originates in membrane biophysics, channel-mediated transport, or intracellular clearance is unresolved. We dissect the question for U87-MG glioblastoma cells versus normal astrocytes by combining all-atom molecular dynamics of the two unoxidized plasma membranes with an experiment-anchored transfer-function model of \( H _2 O _2 \) influx. Simulations of unoxidized bilayers demonstrate that physiological cholesterol enrichment in glioblastoma membranes marginally increases lipid packing and acyl-chain order, conferring no baseline passive permeability advantage on the malignant cell. While this excludes pristine bilayer ordering as an intrinsic source of differential uptake, it establishes that any membrane-level selectivity must arise downstream from regulated protein conduits or differential susceptibility to oxidative pore formation, rather than pre-existing lipid biophysical disparities. We show that intracellular dose is governed by a single dimensionless transport number Φ ("influx"÷"clearance" ) whose regime switch defines selectivity. Global sensitivity analysis reveals that while AQP8 abundance exhibits a modest local variance index () once influx is saturated, channel over-expression serves as a mandatory, non-linear permissive gate: it transitions the malignant cell across the critical transport boundary (Φ>1). Beyond this threshold, the dominant driver dictating the magnitude of cytotoxic divergence is the tumor-specific collapse of catalase-based clearance, with background lipid permeability setting a ceiling. An AlphaFold conformational ensemble (240 models) leaves the AQP8 selectivity filter robustly closed, confirming that resting peroxiporin transport is tightly regulated and rendering the experiment-anchored transfer function the rigorous biophysical choice. Selectivity thus emerges from a regulated transport system—a permissive AQP8 threshold switch paired with an asymmetric clearance collapse—yielding a calculable, platform-testable therapeutic window.
